definitions.gloss: fearfulness; terror; dreadfulness; how frightening (something) is
definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being frightening. Formed by attaching the noun-forming suffix さ to the i-adjective {恐|おそ}ろしい (frightening, terrible).

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}ろしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
⟦{無知|むち}→無知：18641_muchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}ろしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気付|きづ}いた→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: I realized how frightening ignorance is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然災害|しぜんさいがい}→自然災害：29290_shizensaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}ろしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改|あらた}めて⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt anew the terror of natural disasters.

notes:
Noun form of ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧ (frightening). The suffix さ converts an adjective into a noun denoting the quality or degree.

- {恐|おそ}ろしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: tremble with fear
- {恐|おそ}ろしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: feel terror
- {恐|おそ}ろしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: convey how frightening (something) is

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧: fear, dread — the emotion itself, as felt by a person
- {怖|こわ}さ: scariness — more colloquial; everyday register
- {恐|おそ}ろしさ: dreadfulness — the quality of being terrible, often spoken of objectively
